newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa ends subdued day slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa ends subdued day slightly firmer.

text.p: The day had been spent trading in a tight range, with volume low as a public holiday in much of Europe kept many market players away, traders said.
"The volume is pathetic," one trader said. "The European holiday has brought everything to a standstill."
Active July last traded three sterling higher at 1,019 stg. By 1710 GMT, 203 lots had been recorded on July, of a total 1,487.
"I think the market's looking to New York for direction," the trader said.
